name: Birthday Wishes Event for Kamisato Ayato
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today is Kamisato Ayato's birthday, so let's send Kamisato Ayato our best wishes! Write your well wishes in the comments for a chance to win a set of Genshin Impact badges (3 pieces per set)~ P.S.: Don't forget to read Kamisato Ayato's birthday message in your in-game mail!
